description.value:
Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 40. Category: subrace. .

Your base movement speed is 2x your race’s base speed
and you can dash as a bonus action on your turn. While
dashing you may travel vertically or horizontally across
any surface, such as up walls or across water so long as
they do not end their turn there, falling if they do.
